Closed derivative identities establish both correction signs and all constants. Independently reconstructed finite matrix inverses and Fourier evaluations matched in 1604 checker assertions; this numerical evidence is supplementary.

value.rationale: Eventual range preservation is the exact L-infinity stability condition for periodic second-difference penalized smoothing, so its frontier is a natural operator invariant. The theorem quantifies the critical fourth-power grid-size scaling and its nontrivial second-order lattice correction, with opposite signs for even and odd sample counts. These corrections cannot be deduced from the known continuum cutoff alone and matter to sharp finite-size tuning, unlike arbitrary isolated finite computations.
